WITH counts_by_type AS (
  SELECT
    t.tradekind,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.translink) AS transaction_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS a
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = a.translink
  JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref
  GROUP BY t.tradekind
),
shares AS (
  SELECT
    tradekind,
    transaction_count,
    CAST(transaction_count AS REAL) / SUM(transaction_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM counts_by_type
),
averages AS (
  SELECT AVG(transaction_count) AS average_count
  FROM counts_by_type
)
SELECT
  SUM(s.transaction_count) AS sum_counts,
  AVG(s.share) AS average_share,
  AVG(s.transaction_count - a.average_count) AS average_excess
FROM shares AS s
CROSS JOIN averages AS a
WHERE s.transaction_count > a.average_count;
